labels: The shirt sleeves are folded twice into thick cuffs just below both elbows, leaving the forearms exposed beneath the stacked cloth edges.; 셔츠 소매가 양 팔꿈치 바로 아래에서 두 번 접혀 두꺼운 끝단을 이루고 겹친 천 아래로 아래팔이 드러난다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: The shirt sleeves are folded twice into thick cuffs just below both elbows, leaving the forearms exposed beneath the stacked cloth edges.
